markets.3renhuku: sum of the six ordered permutations of an unordered top3 set {i,j,k}
markets.2shatan: sum over all third-place riders k not in {i,j} of P(i,j,k)
markets.2shahuku: P(i ahead of j in top2) + P(j ahead of i in top2), each marginalized over third place
markets.wide: probability both selected riders appear anywhere in top3, marginalized over all positions and third rider

required_validation: ordered_top3 total mass equals 1 within tolerance
marginal identities agree across market projections
no independently fitted probability table may silently replace the ordered_top3 source of truth

required_before_expected_value_label: timestamp-proven market odds for the matching bet type
market_price_comparison_gate.candidate_only_rule: Market odds may be compared with frozen model probability only after the probability-readiness gate is satisfied.

important: The system should search all supported bet types rather than privileging 3rentan.
A combination can be unattractive in one market and attractive in another because market prices differ.
No late-odds movement is interpreted as insider/smart money by default.
Current document does not itself authorize real-money execution or establish profitability.
